scope: isolated local tests with synthetic API catalogs, CLI responses, HTTPS and SSH transports

redundant_guards_consolidated: local_runtime: alternate state already checked by provider scan and selected-state guard
selectel_adapter: VM identity and ACTIVE status already checked before database-host validation

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: Later API pages could hide a public address on an internal ES port or valid placement groups and routers.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Use the existing complete collection paginator for floating IPs, placement groups and routers.

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: Cached SSH source delivery could include hidden files, media, SQLite databases and private keys.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Reject source links and filter runtime and private files before archiving.

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: Failure of scheduler fault diagnostics could replace the original deployment exception during retry classification.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Avoid diagnostics for non-Terraform failures and preserve the original error and resources when fault retrieval fails.

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: A failed download or SHA512 mismatch left a temporary partial package.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Remove the partial file in finally; publish only after successful verification.

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: The source archive could include secrets.json from an otherwise allowed directory.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Exclude secrets.json while retaining regular public source files.

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: Cleanup attempted deletion of shared parent resources after child deletion failed, leaving a network occupied by an own VM until provider timeout.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Continue independent node deletion but preserve parent stages after a dependency failure; explicit retry finishes deletion before the final state/API audit.

regressions_confirmed_before_fix.defect: Read-only post-binding VM, port and floating IP observations blocked a repeat plan whose existing resource actions were all no-op.
regressions_confirmed_before_fix.fix: Validate saved identities and ownership and accept only bounded initial-binding observations; planned writes remain forbidden.

additional_acceptance_cases: Actual remote SQL, application and media verification workers with isolated synthetic runtime directories
Verified source and all three Elastic package downloads through an in-memory HTTPS transport
Interrupted downloads, exact length and SHA512 validation, cached file preservation, redirect downgrade and unsafe archives
Stale identities, foreign state, unfinished test-cycle, recovery markers and retained cleanup information
Provider capabilities, existing subnet conflicts, alternate flavors and active-stand preflight without new allocation
Terraform plan guards, indexed resource identities, lock reuse and operation lock release on interruption
S3 ownership binding, release confirmation, namespace isolation and incomplete cleanup recovery
Network filtering, physical host separation, log probes, package delivery modes and original CLI dispatch
Scheduler hint structure and saved-group comparisons survive confirmed local cleanup without persisting arbitrary values
Equivalent empty scheduler defaults preserve the configured group; group changes, constraints and planned writes remain forbidden
A failed node blocks only its dependent pool stages; an independent pool completes network cleanup
A real clean local Git clone consumes a versioned release through synthetic HTTPS without S3 credentials
Release construction rejects dirty trees, unsafe tracked archives, changed packages and repository mutation
Ansible systemd operation survives mock connection interruptions and controller restart without a duplicate run
Ansible stop/cgroup confirmation gates VM deletion, and finalizer failures preserve the original error
Selectel common network domains are selected from exact/unique same-pool API declarations without widening image or disk policy
Both explicitly allowed Glance MD5 builds pass independently of property checks; unknown checksums and incompatible images fail closed
ru-4 and ru-5 are excluded while saved VM/image placement identities remain unchanged
Standalone controller, legacy contracts and failed-attempt cleanup use isolated synthetic provider state
Current-project clean Git clone consumes release in an isolated offline process, and release binding preserves concurrent edits
Explicit ES failover restores the saved per-pool VM; es4 addition and retry preserve existing IDs and data through the staged controller
limitation: Local tests do not establish cloud operability or replace the separately authorized Selectel test-cycle.
